title: An Orc village
text: Grak wakes in his village. Roofs have fallen in, and smoke is still rising from the houses.

title: Looking for survivors
text: Grak calls for the others and searches the wreckage. He finds bodies, but no one answers.

title: The road
text: The next village is the same. Grak keeps walking toward the capital, looking for someone alive.

title: The Rotunda
text: In the capital, he goes down to the treasure vault beneath the Rotunda. Malgrath is lying on his gold.

title: Malgrath
speaker: MALGRATH
text: Keep your hands where I can see them, orc.

title: The invasion
speaker: MALGRATH
text: Dead, most of them. The guild came through the villages, then the city. They came down here for me.

title: The first attack
speaker: MALGRATH
text: Enough to make the rest retreat. I could barely get back down the stairs.

title: Another attack
speaker: MALGRATH
text: A few are still in the city. They'll try again, and more will follow. I cannot fight like that again.

title: The entrance
speaker: GRAK
text: Then we block the ways in. Give me gold. I can build defenses.

title: The hoard
speaker: MALGRATH
text: You have a hammer. Use that.

title: The cost
speaker: GRAK
text: Need timber. Iron. Weapons. Hammer won't buy them.

title: An offer
speaker: MALGRATH
text: Take what is beside the steps. Leave the rest.

title: The first defense
speaker: GRAK
text: I'll start upstairs. In the Rotunda.

title: The agreement
speaker: MALGRATH
text: Keep them there. I've had enough visitors down here.

title: Preparations
text: Grak takes the gold upstairs to fortify the Rotunda. The invaders still in town must pass through it to reach Malgrath.
